accepted_scope: Cardinality-doubling wrapper, balanced unbounded four-/six-word variable components, necessary small-count reductions, short-window sufficient count criteria, exact common-context multiplicities and endpoint Gram-matrix reductions.
wrapper_bound_scope: The balanced examples disprove only a variable-component-size bound required uniformly across all families of the specified counts. They do not obstruct a dimension bound restricted to hypothetical unbalanced counterexamples.
window_thresholds: Three-label reversal: Z<=9, or Z<=9W in qualifying weighted contexts. Four-label support: Z<=6 for one witness; weighted sums require one fixed certified pair. Relocation across k letters: Z<=3 floor((k+1)/2), or the same factor times W. All inequalities are inclusive and conditional.
endpoint_block_meaning: Unique pressability refers to the symmetric Gram matrices of the triangular endpoint blocks. No external unique-root characterization is a proof dependency.

public_edition.meaning: These are both final original mathematical decisions. Additional independent review of this precise public editorial edition remains a separate gate.
